I didn’t have the [Corruptor] class until this year!
The [Corruptor] ground her teeth together as they walked back to one of the biggest, sprawling mansion-complexes.

The [Corruptor] pointedly angled them towards the elevators. 8th Floor, The Wandering Inn. She had to get Numbtongue thinking like her. The inn was better; he was unhappier there. His smile faded as they ascended the elevators, and Salkis relaxed slightly.
